details: The scrubber 'input' event calls renderClean() directly on every mousemove without RAF coalescing, triggering full DOM mutations (24 rects + 24 circles + 2 path updates) at up to 60fps; the animation loop itself correctly uses requestAnimationFrame. No D3 transitions are used so there is no handoff race, scales are static so no stale closure risk, and there is no cross-view dispatch so no infinite loop concern.
